meta.title: Batch Image Processor - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Process multiple images at once: compress, resize, convert format, or add watermarks.
dragCornersToCrop: Drag corners or region to crop
wmDragHint: Drag on preview to rotate · or use the slider below
drawTextHint: Click to edit · drag to move
batchDropHint: Drop images or click to select
batchHint: Up to 20 images · JPG, PNG, WebP
jpegHighQualityWarning: High quality on compressed JPEG may increase file size.
steps_image-batch_1Desc: Select or drag in a batch of images to process together. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, and WebP. All files stay on your device — nothing is uploaded to a server.
steps_image-batch_2Desc: Select what to do with the batch: compress, resize to specific dimensions, convert format, or add watermarks. Settings apply uniformly to every image in the queue.
steps_image-batch_3Desc: Click Process to apply the operation to every image. Download results individually or as a single ZIP file. Ideal for preparing product photos, thumbnails, or web assets in bulk.
desc: Process multiple images at once: compress, resize, convert format, or add watermarks.
